content.rendered: Come and learn how you can get involved with our school, including Fun Run and many other upcoming activities and events. Open House is September 11th, 5:00-5:30, in Portable 43. If you are able, feel free to stay for our monthly meeting beginning at 5:30. We hope to see you there!
